replies.author: profbananaslug
replies.body:
ethics questionnaire:
1. did u harm any animals while building the map
2. did u employ any black people to build the map, and if so, did u pay them
3. how many bodies are there buried in the map
4. is the map gluten free
5. was the map built on an indian burial ground

also i worry this map may have too much void in the center for a 4 team ctw map
it gets a bit hectic when u are able to be shot by 75% of the people playing on the map rather than 50%, and also usually they come from both sides at once

replies.author: Stuarts
replies.body:
ethics answers:

1.I ate a hamburger while building the map.
2.Nah they were orphans so no worries.
3.I have no frickin' clue .....but I admit that sometimes I do hear screams..
4.Why yes , there are no traces of wheat.
5.No , it was built over a void.

And , sorry for the maxed FOV , but my screen is pretty large and when I screen-capture it kinda distortions the image.
I agree that there might be too much void , but between the center and the mini-island , there are only 10 blocks of void seperating them. I thought of altering or at least tweaking the spaces , but then the map would be too easy as a result. And indeed people will be shot off , but in the end since it's CTW all sides will be connected to the center. However I will try and make the center so you only get shot off by 50% of the map instead of 75% , as I now see that there is indeed the possibility to be shot directly from the opposite team symetrical ti you.
